loudness.quote: Title: "SEGFAULT in prune_requests_older_than() if pruned_requests are not provided"

resolution.quote: PR #2008 "fix nullptr dereference in prune_requests_older_than" merged into rolling 2022-12-13, changing rclcpp/include/rclcpp/client.hpp and adding regression tests in rclcpp/test/rclcpp/test_client.cpp.

notes: Independently verified: issue #2007 title and body verbatim, including the documented default-argument call "client->prune_requests_older_than(someTimeAgo /*, nullptr by default */);" and the documentation quote "[inout] pruned_requests Removed requests id will be pushed to the vector if a pointer is provided."; the blob at dab9f5e0a331b9694c4b5aceb8263d49aa052ecb — client.hpp lines 765-780 show the loop whose line 772 is the unchecked "pruned_requests->push_back(it->first);"; PR #2008's title, merge (rolling, 2022-12-13), file list (client.hpp + test_client.cpp), and the null-check diff quoted above. My independent reading matches the spec: the crash is a null-pointer dereference in rclcpp's own implementation, reached by any caller that uses the documented default argument; the caller's use matches rclcpp's own declared API and documentation, so the mismatch is between rclcpp's documentation/default and its own code, and the failure would occur with any correct caller — tree step 2 internal. The spec's note that no crash log is quoted in the thread but the merged fix plus regression tests confirm the defect is accurate. Ineligible stands.
